shared_elements: horizontal band(s) of repeated geometric pattern
low-relief carving organised in stacked registers
repeated small rectangular/square units in a row
justification: Both surfaces are organised into horizontal registers containing rows of repeated small rectilinear units, which is the only real correspondence and is a generic device. A is dominated by identifiable creatures in profile (a carnivore with raised paw, birds, a small human-like figure, a snake-headed form) arranged around the animal frieze, whereas B shows essentially nothing but abstract banded grid-like ornament with no recognisable creature or figure.
